title: Priority: stop-the-line judges re-runs of older runs; comment wording; run-list limit
evidence: (a) tools/merge-gated.sh step 7 (PR 1568) counts a not-completed run on attempt 2+ as red only when it is the newest run. GitHub keeps createdAt across re-runs, so a re-run of an OLDER red run under a newer first-attempt run (in progress or cancelled) drops out of the completed set and an older green run is judged. Reproduced with the script's own jq filter. Fix: any not-completed run with attempt >= 2 at or newer than the judged run is red; test both shapes. (b) The fix-main PR comment says main's CI was red even when the gate stopped for a re-run of a green run; say red or re-running. (c) --limit 20 applies before the pull_request filter, so 20 fork pull_request runs on a branch named main leave nothing to judge (exit 4, fails closed)
